title: Good morning
subtitle: Waiting for this Mac’s date to be right.
headline: This Mac’s date looks earlier than before
body: Sidekick last ran on 12 Oct 2026, but this Mac’s date now reads 9 Oct 2026. It can’t check your beta access until the date is right. Open System Settings › General › Date & Time and check it. If the date is already right, ask the person who invited you to the beta for a new token — entering it fixes this.
gateMessage: Thank you — beta access until 25 Nov 2026.
toasts: Thank you — beta access until 25 Nov 2026.
